# Learning path

12 units that take you from A1 to B1. Each unit teaches a few grammar patterns with vocabulary, around an everyday situation. Work through them in order on the [learning site](https://jyltsang.github.io/Cantonlink-community/#/path), which tracks your progress, or read them here.

## 1. Meeting people · 打招呼 (daa2 ziu1 fu1) · A1

*Greet people, say who you are, and ask simple yes-or-no questions.*

- [Subject + 係 + Noun](grammar/hai6-copula.md) — to be (identity)
- [唔 + Verb / Adjective](grammar/m4-negation.md) — not
- [… 嗎？](grammar/maa3-question.md) — neutral yes/no question
- [… 呀](grammar/aa3-softener.md) — friendly softener for questions and replies
- [Noun / Pronoun + 嘅 + Noun](grammar/ge3-possessive.md) — 's / of (possession and description)

Vocabulary: [Greetings and courtesy](vocabulary/greetings.md)

## 2. Numbers and prices · 數字同價錢 (sou3 zi6 tung4 gaa3 cin4) · A1

*Count things, point at them, and ask what they cost and whether there are any.*

- [Number + Classifier + Noun](grammar/number-classifier.md) — counting things
- [呢 / 嗰 + Classifier (+ Noun)](grammar/ni1-go2-demonstratives.md) — this / that
- [… 幾多錢？](grammar/gei2-do1-cin2.md) — How much is…?
- [有 / 冇 + Noun](grammar/jau5-mou5.md) — to have; there is / there isn't
- [有冇 + Noun？](grammar/jau5-mou5-question.md) — Is there…? / Do you have…?

Vocabulary: [Numbers, money and time](vocabulary/numbers-money-time.md)

## 3. Eating out · 飲茶 (jam2 caa4) · A1

*Order food and drink, say what you want, and choose between options.*

- [想 + Verb](grammar/soeng2-want.md) — would like to / want to
- [要 + Noun / Verb](grammar/jiu3-want-need.md) — to want (something); to need to / have to
- [… 啦](grammar/laa1-suggestion.md) — suggestion, invitation or gentle request
- [A 定係 B？](grammar/ding6-hai6-or.md) — …or…? (choosing in a question)
- [乜嘢 / 咩](grammar/mat1-je5-what.md) — what

Vocabulary: [Food and dim sum](vocabulary/food-and-dim-sum.md)

## 4. Family and friends · 屋企人 (uk1 kei2 jan4) · A1

*Talk about the people in your life and describe them.*

- [A + 同 + B](grammar/tung4-and-with.md) — and; with
- [好 + Adjective](grammar/hou2-very.md) — very
- [Verb + 唔 + Verb？](grammar/a-not-a-question.md) — yes/no question (A-not-A)
- [邊度 / 邊個 / 邊 + Classifier](grammar/bin1-where-who.md) — where / who / which

Vocabulary: [Family and people](vocabulary/family-and-people.md)

## 5. Getting around · 搭車 (daap3 ce1) · A1

*Say where you are, when you are going, and what you have done or are doing.*

- [Subject + 喺 + Place](grammar/hai2-location.md) — to be at / in
- [幾時 + Verb？](grammar/gei2-si4-when.md) — when
- [Verb + 咗](grammar/zo2-completed.md) — completed action
- [Verb + 緊](grammar/gan2-progressive.md) — in the middle of doing (-ing)
- [唔好 + Verb](grammar/m4-hou2-dont.md) — don't (telling someone not to)

Vocabulary: [Transport and MTR](vocabulary/transport.md)

## 6. Shopping · 買嘢 (maai5 je5) · A2

*Compare things, say something is too dear, and ask if you may try or pay.*

- [太 + Adjective + 喇](grammar/taai3-too.md) — too (much)
- [A + Adjective + 過 + B](grammar/gwo3-comparison.md) — A is more … than B
- [可唔可以 + Verb？](grammar/ho2-ji5-may.md) — may I…? / could you…?
- [Owner + Classifier + Noun](grammar/classifier-possessive.md) — my / your / her (a specific thing)
- [畀 + Thing + Person](grammar/bei2-give.md) — to give

Vocabulary: [Shopping](vocabulary/shopping.md)

## 7. Asking the way · 問路 (man6 lou6) · A2

*Ask how to get somewhere and why, and say what you know how to do.*

- [點(樣) + Verb？](grammar/dim2-how.md) — how (to do something)
- [點解 …？](grammar/dim2-gaai2-why.md) — why
- [Verb + 吓](grammar/haa5-briefly.md) — do briefly; have a go
- [識 + Verb](grammar/sik1-know-how.md) — know how to; can (a learned skill)

Vocabulary: [Directions](vocabulary/directions.md)

## 8. Daily life · 日常生活 (jat6 soeng4 sang1 wut6) · A2

*Describe your day: what you have finished, what you have not done yet, and what you have ever done.*

- [Verb + 咗 + … 未？ / 未 + Verb](grammar/mei6-yet.md) — …yet? / not yet
- [Verb + 完](grammar/jyun4-finish.md) — finish doing
- [已經 + … + 喇](grammar/ji5-ging1-already.md) — already
- [… 喇](grammar/laa3-change.md) — change of situation; 'now'
- [Verb + 過](grammar/gwo3-experience.md) — have ever done (experience)

Vocabulary: [Home and daily routine](vocabulary/home-and-routine.md)

## 9. Seeing a doctor · 睇醫生 (tai2 ji1 sang1) · A2

*Describe how you feel, give reasons, and understand advice.*

- [應該 + Verb](grammar/jing1-goi1-should.md) — should; ought to; probably
- [唔使 + Verb](grammar/m4-sai2-no-need.md) — no need to; don't have to
- [會 + Verb](grammar/wui5-will.md) — will; would; likely to
- [因為 …，所以 …](grammar/jan1-wai6-because.md) — because …, so …
- [Subject + 都 + Verb](grammar/dou1-also.md) — also; both / all
- [… 咩？](grammar/me1-surprise.md) — surprised question ('really?')

Vocabulary: [Health and the doctor](vocabulary/health.md)

## 10. At work · 返工 (faan1 gung1) · B1

*Talk about tasks and results, how well things went, and what to do first.*

- [Verb + 到 / Verb + 唔到](grammar/dou2-result.md) — manage to; can't manage to
- [Verb + 得 + Adjective](grammar/dak1-degree.md) — how well / how fast someone does something
- [Verb + 晒](grammar/saai3-all.md) — all; completely; entirely
- [Verb + 返](grammar/faan1-back.md) — back; again; return to a previous state
- [先 … 再 … / … 先](grammar/sin1-zoi3-first-then.md) — first …, then …
- [一 …就 …](grammar/jat1-zau6-as-soon-as.md) — as soon as …; whenever …

Vocabulary: [Work and the office](vocabulary/work.md), [Tech and work](vocabulary/tech-work.md)

## 11. Weather and plans · 天氣同計劃 (tin1 hei3 tung4 gai3 waak6) · B1

*Make plans that depend on the weather, and talk about changes and impressions.*

- [如果 …，就 …](grammar/jyu4-gwo2-if.md) — if …, then …
- [雖然 …，但係 …](grammar/seoi1-jin4-although.md) — although …, (but) …
- [越嚟越 + Adjective](grammar/jyut6-lai4-jyut6.md) — more and more …
- [好似 …](grammar/hou2-ci5-seem.md) — seems; looks like; to be like
- [Verb + 出 / 入 / 上 / 落 + 嚟 / 去](grammar/directional.md) — direction of movement

Vocabulary: [Weather](vocabulary/weather.md)

## 12. Telling stories · 講故事 (gong2 gu3 si6) · B1

*Tell what happened and how you felt, react to news, and describe people and things in detail.*

- [Subject + 畀 + Doer + Verb](grammar/bei2-passive.md) — passive: was done by
- [[Description] + 嘅 + Noun](grammar/relative-ge3.md) — the … that / who … (relative clauses)
- [Verb + 住](grammar/zyu6-continuous.md) — keep doing; in a continuing state
- [… 囉](grammar/lo1-obvious.md) — it's obvious; oh well
- [… 喎](grammar/wo3-noticing.md) — noticing something; passing on what someone said

Vocabulary: [Feelings](vocabulary/feelings.md)
